high_level_description: The image is a promotional graphic for family support measures related to preschool affordability and the upliftment of lower-income households as part of Budget 2024. The text at the top reads: "Budget 2024: Family support measures to make preschools more affordable, uplift lower-income households." Below this text, there is a button labeled "HELP FOR FAMILIES" with a pink chain icon. The background features a group of children dressed in red pants and white shirts with blue accents, holding colorful dragon puppets.
